source.title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
source.excerpt: Case studies on five popular agent applications across eight attack incidents show that an analyst using Origin correctly identifies all the CEPs.

cards.headline: Digital Health and Artificial Intelligence for Public Health Systems in Africa

source.title: Digital Health and Artificial Intelligence for Public Health Systems in Africa: A Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: Simple, interoperable, government-led tools have the strongest evidence of benefit at scale in Africa. AI requires prospective, locally validated evaluation of patient outcomes, and investment should prioritize governance, interoperability, inclusion, and sustainable domestic financing.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Chronic Coronary Syndromes

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Chronic Coronary Syndromes: Linking Cellular Pathways to Precision Risk Prediction.
source.excerpt: The greatest value of AI in CCS is likely to lie in augmenting mechanistic risk stratification and enabling precision prevention for patients whose risk is poorly captured by anatomy alone.

cards.headline: Zwergohreule

source.title: Zwergohreule
source.excerpt: Die Zwergohreule ist nach dem Sperlingskauz die kleinste europäische Eule, sie erreicht knapp Amselgröße. Die Art ist in fünf Unterarten aufgeteilt, die jedoch recht wenig differenziert sind. Die früher als Unterart der Zwergohreule eingeordnete Zypern-Zwergohreule wird mittlerweile als eigene, auf Zypern endemische Art betrachtet.

source.title: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
source.excerpt: The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.

cards.headline: Module-specific diagnostic accuracy of ADOS-2 in real-world clinical referral populations

source.title: Module-specific diagnostic accuracy of ADOS-2 in real-world clinical referral populations: an updated systematic review and HSROC meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: ADOS-2 demonstrates high overall sensitivity but variable specificity across modules in real-world clinical referral populations. Reduced specificity was more commonly observed in higher ADOS-2 modules, which are typically administered to verbally fluent adolescents and adults with greater psychiatric complexity.

cards.headline: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Brucellosis

source.title: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Brucellosis: Diagnosis, Genomic Analysis, Epidemiological Prediction and Drug Discovery.
source.publisher: Animals : an open access journal from MDPI
source.excerpt: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first review to integrate AI applications across the entire chain of brucellosis prevention and control and to propose a conceptual framework for AI-driven intelligent brucellosis management.

cards.headline: Mike Tyson

source.title: Mike Tyson
source.excerpt: Michael Gerard „Mike“ Tyson ist ein ehemaliger US-amerikanischer Schwergewichtsboxer. Mit einem Alter von 20 Jahren und 144 Tagen war er 1986 der bislang jüngste Boxer, der einen Weltmeistertitel im Schwergewicht erringen konnte.

cards.headline: Machine Learning in Palliative Care: Scoping Review of Applications

source.title: Machine Learning in Palliative Care: Scoping Review of Applications.
source.excerpt: ML applications in palliative care are expanding beyond prognostication toward patient-centered uses, including symptom management, clinical decision support, and resource planning. The persistent gap in equity reporting (105/121, 86.8% did not report equity considerations) signals that the field risks developing tools that may not perform equitably across diverse populations.

cards.headline: Agentic AI and related systems in nursing and nursing-adjacent work

source.title: Agentic AI and related systems in nursing and nursing-adjacent work: a scoping review of task allocation, decision authority, and accountability.
source.excerpt: Agentic capability alone does not establish clinical readiness. Expanding AI-enabled functions requires evidence of meaningful benefit, effective human control, and accountability arrangements proportionate to the consequences of system actions.

cards.headline: Melbourne

source.title: Melbourne
source.excerpt: Melbourne [ˈmɛɫbən] ist die Hauptstadt des Bundesstaates Victoria in Australien. Sie ist mit etwa 5,207 Millionen Einwohnern nach Sydney die zweitgrößte Stadt Australiens. Die Einwohner von Melbourne werden im Englischen Melburnians genannt. Melbourne wurde 1837 nach dem damaligen britischen Premierminister Lord Melbourne benannt und ist katholischer sowie anglikanischer Erzbischofssitz.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence for lung cancer

source.title: Artificial intelligence for lung cancer: a systematic review of head‑to‑head CT, FDG PET/CT, and multimodal models across screening, staging, and prognosis.
source.excerpt: Comparative evidence demonstrates that modality performance is context-dependent: CT dominates in screening, PET/CT fusion excels in staging and prognosis, and multimodal integration with clinical or biomarker data enhances discrimination and utility. Standardization, harmonization, and rigorous external validation remain critical for generalizability. Clinical trial number: Not applicable.

source.title: Effects of Exercise on Symptom Burden During Cancer Treatment: Real-World Evidence from a Statewide Exercise Oncology Program.
source.publisher: Medicine and science in sports and exercise
source.excerpt: Similar exercise programs may be considered during cancer treatment for symptom control.

cards.headline: An dem Tag, da (die einen) Gesichter weiß und (die anderen) Gesichter schwarz sein werden.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:106
source.excerpt: يوم القيامة تَبْيَضُّ وجوه أهل السعادة الذين آمنوا بالله ورسوله، وامتثلوا أمره، وتَسْوَدُّ وجوه أهل الشقاوة ممن كذبوا رسوله، وعصوا أمره. فأما الذين اسودَّت وجوههم، فيقال لهم توبيخًا: أكفرتم بعد إيمانكم، فاخترتم الكفر على الإيمان؟ فذوقوا العذاب بسبب كفركم.

cards.arabic: يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ أَكَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
cards.translation: An dem Tag, da (die einen) Gesichter weiß und (die anderen) Gesichter schwarz sein werden. Was nun diejenigen angeht, deren Gesichter schwarz sein werden (, so wird zu ihnen gesagt werden): Seid ihr ungläubig geworden, nachdem ihr den Glauben (angenommen) hattet? So kostet die Strafe dafür, daß ihr wieder ungläubig geworden seid.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Was aber diejenigen angeht, deren Gesichter weiß sein werden …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:107
source.excerpt: وأما الذين ابيضَّتْ وجوهم بنضرة النعيم، وما بُشِّروا به من الخير، فهم في جنة الله ونعيمها، وهم باقون فيها، لا يخرجون منها أبدًا.

cards.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
cards.translation: Was aber diejenigen angeht, deren Gesichter weiß sein werden, so werden sie sich in Allahs Erbarmen befinden. Ewig werden sie darin bleiben.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

source.excerpt: These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.

cards.headline: Association between SIRT1 gene polymorphisms and susceptibility to coronary artery disease

source.title: Association between SIRT1 gene polymorphisms and susceptibility to coronary artery disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Current evidence suggests that certain SIRT1 polymorphisms may be associated with CAD susceptibility, but the observed associations appear to vary by SNP locus, genetic model, and population or disease subgroup.

cards.headline: Factors associated with cancer-related fatigue in breast cancer patients

source.title: Factors associated with cancer-related fatigue in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The patients with cancer- related fatigue in breast cancer, pain, dyspnea, anxiety, depression, sleep disturbances (OR 2.02, 95% CI 1.05-3.87) and BMI ≥ 30 kg/m may be associated with fatigue and should be considered as potential related factors.

source.title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
source.excerpt: Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

cards.headline: Central Nervous System Involvement in Acute Myeloid Leukemia

source.title: Central Nervous System Involvement in Acute Myeloid Leukemia: From Pathophysiology to Neuroradiologic Features and the Emerging Role of Artificial Intelligence.
source.excerpt: Combining AI-based image analysis with multimodal neuroimaging could significantly improve diagnostic accuracy and personalized treatment for CNS involvement in AML. Progress is still challenged by the rarity of the condition and the lack of large, annotated datasets.

cards.headline: AI-empowered human microbiome research

source.title: AI-empowered human microbiome research.
source.excerpt: By critically evaluating the current capabilities and limitations of AI in this context, this review aims to chart a path forward for the integration of AI into microbiome research, ultimately accelerating innovations in personalised medicine and deepening our understanding of host-microbiome relationships.

cards.headline: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes

source.title: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
source.excerpt: Empirically, CDP stepsizes produce a flattening effect similar to that of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM, Foret et al., 2021), reducing sharpness even in settings beyond our theory, including nonlinear teacher-student networks and fine-tuning of pre-trained LLMs.

cards.headline: Navigating the AI Landscape in Medical Imaging

source.title: Navigating the AI Landscape in Medical Imaging: A Critical Analysis of Technologies, Implementation, and Implications.
source.excerpt: This review addresses integration challenges, pathways for responsible progress, and the viewpoints of all stakeholders.

cards.headline: Safeguarding biomedical AI

source.title: Safeguarding biomedical AI: a critical scoping review of privacy-enhancing technologies, hybrid approaches, and deployment models.
source.excerpt: Situating PETs within technical and operational contexts clarifies their capabilities, limitations, and deployment challenges. Residual risks persist, including fairness concerns, inference-time leakage, and overreliance on PETs as compliance proxies. Sustained technical innovation and institutional governance remain essential for the trustworthy integration of PETs in biomedical AI.

cards.headline: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces

source.excerpt: We show how to keep such a search honest, and estimate how much more data each component needs before a club could rely on it.

cards.headline: ChatGPT and Other Large Language Models in Inflammatory Arthritis

source.title: ChatGPT and Other Large Language Models in Inflammatory Arthritis: A Systematic Review Across Clinical Tasks.
source.excerpt: LLMs may support patient education, factual medication queries, and structured guideline questions when used under clinician review, but should not be used for case-based reasoning, treatment selection, or autonomous clinical decisions. None of the 18 included studies evaluated retrieval-augmented or agent-based systems, and none prospectively validated LLMs in clinical workflows.

cards.headline: Mobile pharmacovigilance: a comprehensive review

source.title: Mobile pharmacovigilance: a comprehensive review.
source.excerpt: Emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, electronic health record integration, blockchain, and advanced data analytics are expected to further transform mobile pharmacovigilance. Overall, mobile applications represent a promising strategy for strengthening global pharmacovigilance systems by enabling timely, accurate, patient-centered, and efficient drug safety monitoring.

cards.headline: Dies sind die Zeichen Allahs, die Wir der Wahrheit entsprechend verlesen.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:108
source.excerpt: هذه آيات الله وبراهينه الساطعة، نتلوها ونقصُّها عليك -أيها الرسول- بالصدق واليقين. وما الله بظالم أحدًا من خلقه، ولا بمنقص شيئًا من أعمالهم; لأنه الحاكم العدل الذي لا يجور.

cards.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
cards.translation: Dies sind die Zeichen Allahs, die Wir der Wahrheit entsprechend verlesen. Und Allah will keine Ungerechtigkeit für die Weltenbewohner
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Allah gehört (alles), was in den Himmeln und was auf der Erde ist …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:109
source.excerpt: ولله ما في السموات وما في الأرض، ملكٌ له وحده خلقًا وتدبيرًا، ومصير جميع الخلائق إليه وحده، فيجازي كلا على قدر استحقاقه.

cards.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
cards.translation: Allah gehört (alles), was in den Himmeln und was auf der Erde ist, und zu Allah werden (all) die Angelegenheiten zurückgebracht.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
